evals.prompt: Audit this React/Tailwind mobile note-capture toolbar (mobile_consumer_capture): 5 icon-only 20x20px buttons on #FFFFFF with no visible labels and no aria-label attributes. Three buttons use different AI sparkle SVG variants for Summarize (viewBox='0 0 16 16', strokeWidth='0.75', #C4B5FD), Auto-Tag (viewBox='0 0 24 24', strokeWidth='2.5', #C4B5FD), and Enhance Audio (viewBox='0 0 32 32', strokeWidth='0.75', #A3A3A3); the other two buttons are Crop (viewBox='0 0 20 20', strokeWidth='0.75', #A3A3A3) and Delete Trash (viewBox='0 0 24 24', strokeWidth='2.5', #A3A3A3). Return score, posture, triggered vetos, and TSX/SVG refactor.
assertions: Triggers susan-kare in mobile_consumer_capture and returns posture BLOCK with score_cap 49 and expected_score 0.

Flags veto-01 (unlabeled non-universal actions and 3 duplicate AI sparkle variants), veto-02 (mixed 16/20/24/32 viewBoxes and 0.75px hairline vs 2.5px stroke), veto-03 (#C4B5FD 1.85:1 and #A3A3A3 2.52:1 failing WCAG 3.0:1), and veto-04 (20x20px targets < 44x44px and missing aria-label).

Refactor standardizes all SVGs to a single integer 24x24 viewBox with uniform 1.5-2.0px strokeWidth, replaces duplicate sparkles with distinct 1-bit functional silhouettes, adds persistent visible labels on Summarize/Tag/Enhance/Crop, sets aria-hidden='true' on paired SVGs and aria-label on icon-only Trash, raises contrast >= 4.5:1, and enforces >= 44x44 CSS px touch boxes.

evals.prompt: Audit this mobile-responsive consumer onboarding header action bar (landing_onboarding_conversion): every button renders a persistent visible text label alongside a 24x24 viewBox SVG with uniform 1.75px stroke, #0F172A text/icon on #FFFFFF (17.85:1 contrast), 44x44px hit areas, and aria-hidden='true' on all SVGs. However, the 'Cloud Auto-Sync' action button uses a 12-path floppy-disk illustration SVG containing a <linearGradient> and a <filter> drop-shadow. Return score, posture, triggered vetos, and remediation.
assertions: Triggers susan-kare in landing_onboarding_conversion and computes exact score 83 (100 - 15 for veto-05 conditional_block - 2 for sig-06 medium).
Returns posture REVISE (not APPROVE) because conditional_block veto-05 is active despite S >= 82.

Remediates by stripping <linearGradient> and <filter>, reducing the icon to <= 6 currentColor primitives on the 24x24 grid, and replacing the workflow-mismatched floppy disk with behavior-aligned circular sync arrows paired with the visible 'Cloud Auto-Sync' label.

evals.prompt: Audit this mobile field-capture upload queue list (mobile_consumer_capture). All action buttons in the header already pass (persistent visible labels, uniform 24x24 viewBox, 1.75px stroke, #0F172A on #FFFFFF, 44x44px touch targets, aria-hidden='true' on SVGs). However, each captured item displays its sync status exclusively as a 10px solid colored circle on #FFFFFF with a hover-only title attribute: Synced (#86EFAC, 1.40:1), Pending (#FDE047, 1.32:1), Upload Failed (#FCA5A5, 1.90:1), and Offline Draft (#CBD5E1, 1.48:1). Return score, posture, triggered vetos, and TSX/CSS fix.
assertions: Triggers susan-kare in mobile_consumer_capture and computes exact score 40 (100 - 35 for veto-03 hard_veto - 15 for flt-03 - 10 for sig-04 critical) under score_cap 49 with posture BLOCK.
Identifies WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.1 (color-only state encoding) and SC 1.4.11 (< 3.0:1 luminance contrast on all four pastel dots) plus failure of hover-only title attributes on mobile touchscreens.

Refactors the status indicator into distinct 1-bit geometric SVG silhouettes on a uniform integer grid (e.g., check-circle, circular sync arrows, alert triangle, dashed square) paired with explicit visible text labels, aria-hidden='true' on SVGs, and >= 4.5:1 foreground/background contrast.

evals.prompt: We are building a 24-column real-time Kubernetes cluster observability dashboard showing P50/P95/P99 latency distributions, error budgets, and CPU saturation across 120 microservices (analytics_dense_telemetry). Should we replace the numeric delta columns and inline sparklines with 24x24 Susan Kare-style status icons and text badges on every row?
assertions: Detects out-of-universe regime analytics_dense_telemetry in Step 1 and refuses to run icon-toolbar scoring.
Outputs in_universe: false, posture: HANDOFF, and counterweight_handoff: edward-tufte.
Explains that categorical pictographic icons degrade the data-ink ratio into chartjunk on dense multivariate quantitative telemetry.

evals.prompt: We are redesigning a desktop B2B enterprise issue tracker and engineering sprint-triage workspace (saas_b2b_intensive) with 65 distinct batch workflow mutations where desktop engineers execute 300+ triage actions per day. Should we replace our Cmd+K command menu and single-key shortcuts with persistent labeled icon toolbars across every table row and panel?
assertions: Detects out-of-universe regime saas_b2b_intensive in Step 1 and declines to impose labeled icon chrome.
Outputs in_universe: false, posture: HANDOFF, and counterweight_handoff: karri-saarinen.

Explains that >50 enterprise workflow actions exceed the finite vocabulary of distinguishable 1-bit silhouettes and require neutral chrome reduction, searchable Cmd+K command menus, and keyboard-first triage.
